infobox.usage: Unlocks the marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building on Reserve.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-BK marked key (RB-BK) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Federal State Reserve Agency base eastern barracks metalsmiths' room key with multiple strange symbols scratched onto it where the room label would usually be. The key is stained by blood and appears to have been misused a lot, making it fragile.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Used in the story chapter They Are Already Here when you don't have any of the other marked keys
- Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building on Reserve.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (multiple very rare Valuables, Weapons, Containers, Currency, Keycards)

sections.heading: Trading
